method: Phase 2 read of every tests/test_*.py reference to FFmpeg/FFprobe, node/pnpm/git/xcrun/auval/cargo, absolute host paths and the artifacts/ and web/ trees (grep to locate, then the surrounding code read to separate real execution from mocks, sentinels and string fixtures). Not validated by executing the modules under Bazel.

ffmpeg.criterion: executes a real FFmpeg or FFprobe binary (FFMPEG/FFPROBE environment, PATH, or the hash-pinned Nix store path); skips when unavailable

host_tools.criterion: uses node, pnpm or git from PATH, or the hash-pinned Nix FFmpeg path

exclusive.criterion: installs into, builds or serves from the checkout's web/ tree

workspace_artifacts.criterion: reads or creates paths under the checkout's artifacts/ tree (also tagged no-cache)

web_tree.criterion: reads the checkout's web/ tree, which is not a declared input of the Python tests (also tagged no-cache)

all_modules.reason: Every module and worker locates the repository through Path(__file__).resolve(), which leaves the runfiles tree for the real checkout, and many create scratch directories under <checkout>/artifacts; a sandbox would deny those writes.

manual.note: No module was identified that fails, rather than skips, when its host tool is absent. Inference from reading, not from a run.

mentions_ffmpeg_but_not_classified.test_arrangement_reference_tool: sets FFMPEG/FFPROBE to nonexistent paths to prove no decode happens
mentions_ffmpeg_but_not_classified.test_lowreg_spectrogram: command string inside a fixture record
mentions_ffmpeg_but_not_classified.test_nr8_nr10_comparison: fixture paths and a mocked meter
